thread:
Priya Rao: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have noisy paging from the postprocess task. I sketched some action items below, want to confirm owners and dates.

Priya Rao: TL;DR: reduce duplicate pages (dedupe by job id + error fingerprint), raise threshold for transient DB errors, add a 3-min paging suppression window for known flaps.

Samir Patel: Ack. Can you paste the current alert rule?

Priya Rao: Current rule in prod: `alert: PostprocessTaskFailures`
```
expr: increase(sum(rate(postprocess_errors[5m])) by (job), 5) > 10
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPs/pages/12345
```

Morgan Lee: The `for: 1m` is killing us — a single spike triggers a page. Happy to own changing it but want safe fallbacks.

Priya Rao: Proposal: `for: 5m`, change expr to dedupe on `fingerprint` (we have a `error_fingerprint` label in the metric). Also add `suppress_if: increase(postprocess_errors{transient="true"}[10m]) < 3` — i.e., ignore if mostly transient.

Jesse Nguyen: I can own the rule change. I'll open a PR to `infra/alerts/postprocess.yml` with minimal rollout to staging first. Targeting EOD Thursday for PR.

Samir Patel: Thanks Jesse. Once PR is ready, can we run a canary for 48h and report tokenized paging counts? Also add a `runbook` update note: list `how to check` and `how to silence` steps.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: new alert PRs must include a `rollback plan` and `test vector` per policy.

Jesse Nguyen: Noted. Plan in PR: change `for: 5m`, add `group_by: [job, error_fingerprint]`, add `suppression` rule linking to `alert-suppression` playbook. I'll include a `test vector` using `push_gateway` with sample labels.

Tess : Should we also add an exponential backoff for repeated pages within 24h per job? That helped last month for the ingestion pipeline.

Priya Rao: Good idea. Add `paged_until` annotation that silences further pages for same fingerprint for N minutes (configurable). Start with 180 minutes, we can reduce later.

Morgan Lee: For the dedupe key, prefer `error_fingerprint + region`. We had multi-region flaps where deduping across regions hid an actual outage.

Priya Rao: Agree — use `job, error_fingerprint, region`. Update PR request.

Samir Patel: Who's tracking the postmortem action item checklist? We should add owners and a timeline.

Priya Rao: I'll add a short table in the PM doc and in the PR description:
- Jesse Nguyen: PR for rule changes (target: Thu EOD)
- Morgan Lee: Verify staging canary, runbook edits (target: next Tue)
- Samir Patel: Telemetry validation, paging count reporting (48h after rollout)
- Tess : Configure exponential backoff and `paged_until` default (target: Fri)

Jesse Nguyen: I created the PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — please review. It has `rollback: revert commit` and a testing script in `scripts/alert_test.sh`.

Samir Patel: Kicked off the canary namespace now. I'll post aggregated paging numbers tomorrow morning.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident follow-up reminder: owners have 7 days to close action items or set new dates.

Priya Rao: Thanks. If anything slips, ping me with `@Priya Rao` in this thread. Also assigning the ticket in Jira: RDW-4362 and adding owners.

Morgan Lee: One more ask — add a metric to track `pages_per_fingerprint` and `time_between_pages` so we can tune the `paged_until` window empirically. I'll file a small telemetry PR.

Tess : I'll coordinate the backoff config and add a sample snippet to the runbook:
```
annotations:
  paged_until: 180m
  backoff: exponential(1m, 2, 6)
```

Jesse Nguyen: Done, merged to staging. I'll update here when staging metrics look good.

Samir Patel: Staging shows 60% reduction in duplicate pages in the first 3h. Will keep monitoring.

Priya Rao: Great progress. Closing the loop — we'll reconvene in 7 days with a short status update. If we hit regressions, we revert the PR and escalate. :thumbsup:
